name: [W3] Melt The Ice🔥
desc:
🔥 Welcome to Melt The Ice! 🧊

Are you ready to melt your way through the cold? Grab powerful fire weapons, melt through frozen stages, increase your Fire Power, and make it to the end before you freeze!

[How To Play]
• 🔥 Use your weapon to melt the ice!
• 💪 Keep firing to increase your Fire Power!
• 🧊 Break through harder and harder frozen stages!
• 🧥 Upgrade your gear to survive colder areas!
• 🏆 Reach the end, earn Wins, and become stronger!

Can you melt through every stage without freezing? ❄️
